description: Monthly payment, total interest and total paid for a fixed-rate loan with monthly payments: mortgage, car, student or personal loan. Give either loan_amount, or home_price with down_payment_pct for a mortgage. Use when the user asks what a loan costs per month or in total, or how the rate or term changes the cost. Do not use for variable-rate loans, interest-only loans, or credit cards. Excludes taxes, insurance and fees.

down_payment_pct.description: Mortgage only: down payment as % of home_price. Default 20

home_price.description: Mortgage only: home price, in dollars, with down_payment_pct

loan_amount.description: Amount borrowed, in dollars. Give this or home_price

loan_type.description: Type of loan; chooses the SmartFin calculator link. Default mortgage

term_years.description: Loan term in years, e.g. 30 for a mortgage, 5 for a car loan
